tasks.title: Setup Project Repository and Development Environment
tasks.description: Initialize the project repository and set up the development environment for DeckCraft AI.
tasks.details:
1. Create a new Git repository for DeckCraft AI.
2. Initialize a Node.js project with npm.
3. Set up Vite with React and TypeScript for the frontend.
4. Initialize an Express.js project for the backend.
5. Set up ESLint and Prettier for code linting and formatting.
6. Create a basic project structure with folders for frontend, backend, and shared code.
7. Set up a PostgreSQL database for relational data storage.
8. Install and configure Vespa for vector database functionality.
9. Set up environment variables for API keys and configuration.

Dependencies:
- Node.js v16.x or later
- npm v7.x or later
- Git v2.x or later
- PostgreSQL v13.x or later
- Vespa v8.x or later

Key packages:
- vite@4.x
- react@18.x
- typescript@4.x
- express@4.x
- pg@8.x (for PostgreSQL)
- vespa@0.x (unofficial Node.js client for Vespa)
- dotenv@16.x (for environment variables)

2. Implement input validation for merchant industry and geography.

4. Integrate with OpenAI GPT-4 API for content generation.
5. Structure the output as a JSON object with section breakdown and themes.

API Flow:
1. Receive merchant context (industry, geography).
2. Query Vespa for relevant slide chunks.
3. Construct a prompt for GPT-4 using retrieved chunks and merchant context.
4. Generate outline using GPT-4.
5. Post-process and structure the output.

Example GPT-4 prompt:
```
Based on the following context and example slides, generate an outline for a pitch deck:

Merchant Context:
Industry: {industry}
Geography: {geography}

Relevant Slide Examples:
{retrieved_chunks}

Provide a structured outline with the following format:
1. Section Title
   - Key Theme 1
   - Key Theme 2
2. Section Title
   - Key Theme 1
   - Key Theme 2
...
```

<info added on 2025-07-01T05:26:35.039Z>
ENHANCED SLIDE CONTENT READING & OBJECT ID UPDATES IMPLEMENTATION ✅

## Additional Features Implemented Today:

### 📖 Content Reading Endpoint:
- **NEW ENDPOINT**: `GET /api/v1/slides/presentations/{id}/content`
- Reads ALL text content from every slide in a presentation
- Returns structured data with text elements, positions, sizes, and object IDs
- Perfect for content analysis, backup, or AI processing

### 🎯 Object ID-Based Updates:
- Enhanced `TextUpdate` interface to support both index AND object ID targeting
- Added `updateTextByObjectId()` method for precise element targeting
- Object IDs provide immunity to layout changes and element reordering
- Most reliable method for production slide content management

### 🔧 Enhanced Service Methods:
- `getPresentationContent()` - Complete slide content extraction
- `categorizeTextSize()` - Automatic text element size classification (small/medium/large)
- Smart validation requiring either index OR objectId (not both)
- Comprehensive error handling for missing object IDs

### 📋 Complete Postman Collection Updates:
- Added "Get Presentation Content (Read All Text)" request with comprehensive testing
- Added "Update Content by Object ID (Precise Targeting)" request
- Added "Mixed Update Methods (Index + Object ID)" request
- Enhanced existing requests with better documentation and troubleshooting
- All requests include detailed test scripts and error handling validation

### 🎯 Usage Examples:
```json
// Object ID Update (Most Precise)
{
  "slideUpdates": [{
    "slideId": "p",
    "textUpdates": [{
      "objectId": "text-element-object-id-1",
      "text": "Updated by Object ID"
    }]
  }]
}

// Mixed Approach (Maximum Flexibility)
{
  "slideUpdates": [{
    "slideId": "p",
    "title": "Backward compatible",
    "textUpdates": [
      {"index": 1, "text": "By index"},
      {"objectId": "footer-id", "text": "By Object ID"}
    ]
  }]
}
```

### 📊 Complete Bidirectional Workflow:
1. **READ**: `/content` endpoint → Extract all text + object IDs
2. **ANALYZE**: Review content structure and element metadata
3. **TARGET**: Use object IDs for precise element updates
4. **UPDATE**: Mix index/object ID approaches as needed
5. **VERIFY**: Read content again to confirm changes

## Files Updated:
- `/backend/src/services/google-slides.ts` - Enhanced with content reading and object ID support
- `/backend/src/routes/slides.ts` - Added content reading endpoint
- `/docs/DeckCraft_AI_API_Collection.postman_collection.json` - Complete testing suite

## Key Benefits:
✅ **Maximum Precision**: Object IDs target exact elements regardless of layout changes
✅ **Complete Flexibility**: Mix object ID and index approaches in same request
✅ **Backward Compatible**: All existing functionality continues to work
✅ **Production Ready**: Most reliable method for content management workflows
✅ **Comprehensive Testing**: Full Postman collection with error scenarios

The Google Slides integration now provides COMPLETE bidirectional content control with both reading and writing capabilities at the highest precision level possible.

tasks.title: Implement Slide Generation Service
tasks.description: Create the /createGoogleSlides API endpoint that generates Google Slides presentations based on the content outline and merchant info.
tasks.details:
1. Set up an Express.js route for /createGoogleSlides.
2. Implement input validation for outline, merchant info, and asset references.
3. Integrate with Google Slides API using the googleapis library to create a new presentation from a template.
4. Use GPT-4 to generate detailed content for each slide based on the outline.
5. Update Google Slides presentation with generated content and asset references.
6. Implement error handling and retries for Google Slides API calls.

API Flow:
1. Receive outline, merchant info, and asset references.
2. Create a new Google Slides presentation from a template.
3. For each slide in the outline:
   a. Generate detailed content using GPT-4.
   b. Update text placeholders in Google Slides.
   c. Insert asset references into image placeholders.
4. Return the Google Slides presentation URL and sharing permissions.

Example GPT-4 prompt for slide content:
```
Generate detailed content for the following slide:

Slide Title: {slide_title}
Key Themes:
- {theme1}
- {theme2}

Merchant Context:
Industry: {industry}
Geography: {geography}

Provide content in the following format:
- Headline: [A catchy headline for the slide]
- Bullet Points:
  * [Bullet point 1]
  * [Bullet point 2]
  * [Bullet point 3]
- Additional Notes: [Any additional context or information]
```
